name: Vercel
summary: Reads your website's visitors and page views from Vercel Web Analytics every 3 hours, and every 15 minutes whether production is running your branch's newest commit. Redeploy only runs after you approve it.

settings.label: Project name or ID (Vercel → your project → Settings → General → Project Name or Project ID)
Team ID (optional; Vercel → Team Settings → General → Team ID, starts with team_). Empty for a personal account
GitHub repository (optional, owner/name) to warn when production is behind your branch
Production branch (optional; empty = the one Vercel has set, usually main)
Access token (Vercel → Account Settings → Tokens → Create, scoped to the team that owns the project)
GitHub token (optional; only for a private repository: fine-grained, read-only Contents on that repository)
